relationship_to_primary_v30: Independent concurrent execution-sensitivity audit. It did not use primary-v30 results and cannot rescue or supersede its terminal rejection.
hypothesis: Gold has a causal tailwind when both US 10-year real yields and the broad trade-weighted dollar fall, and a headwind when both rise.
falsifier: Reject before XAU performance if the frozen states are too rare, one-sided, concentrated in a few years, or isolated in parameter space.

real_yield.authority: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED; source U.S. Treasury

broad_dollar.authority: Federal Reserve Board H.10 via FRED

information_timing.h10_release: Monday 16:15 America/New_York, next business day after a Monday holiday
information_timing.earliest_decision: Wednesday 00:00 UTC after the observation week
information_timing.lookahead_policy: A full publication buffer is mandatory; same-week or Monday entries are prohibited.

search.state_rule: long if both changes <= negative thresholds; short if both >= positive thresholds; otherwise flat
search.position_rule: one position per contiguous state; remain open until the state becomes flat or reverses

xau_source.mapping_scope: research only; paper and live remain blocked

execution.entry: M15 open at Wednesday 00:00 UTC after the macro observation week
execution.exit: 5% protective stop or M15 open when the weekly macro state becomes flat or reverses
execution.intrabar_policy: gap liquidation, gap stop, then the nearer of dynamic liquidation and fixed stop, then time exit
execution.position_overlap: none; a state reversal closes the old episode before opening the opposite side
execution.data_policy: A Dukascopy M15 bar is usable with at least one observed M1 quote; absent no-tick minutes are not imputed. Gaps are evaluated at the next observed open.

economics.execution_snapshot_status: single open snapshot; provisional research input, never paper authorization
economics.rollover_credit_policy: Never count the current negative long rate as historical profit.
